# Marina Bay geometry

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL) 1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/.

`marina-bay-map.json` is a derived database, distributed under ODbL 1.0. Its coordinates retain real plan distances and positions, rotated into the scene coordinate frame. Only public geometry and architectural tags are retained; contributor identifiers, addresses and contact details are omitted. Building heights use mapped values where available and estimated storey heights otherwise. Geometry is not survey-grade and models are artistic interpretations, not a digital twin.

Architectural references:

- Safdie Architects: https://www.safdiearchitects.com/projects/marina-bay-sands-hotel-and-skypark
- Marina Bay Sands architectural overview and photographs: https://www.marinabaysands.com/guides/exceptional-experiences/architecture-of-mbs.html
- OpenStreetMap 3D outline/part rendering rules: https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Simple_3D_Buildings

The current dataset contains 5,948 building/part records, 5,449 road ways, 3,268 pedestrian ways and 288 green-area records. These are mapped elements, not unique-building or unique-street counts. 274 parent outlines contain detailed parts and are omitted from generic 3D rendering. Planar reflection uses the mapped water polygons; estimated elevations and incomplete coastline/land-cover metadata remain reconstruction limits.

The personal room is an imagined interior, not Josh's home, an actual dwelling reconstruction, or a statement of residence. Its opening sits within the residential tower mass used for the journey. Public story content remains grounded in the portfolio report, separately from geographic scene placement.
